title: 单主体从左向右移动
user_input: 一个穿灰色夹克的年轻男孩从左向右快步移动，镜头轻微跟随，不要切镜。
plain_prompt: A young boy in a gray jacket walks quickly from left to right, the camera gently follows, no cuts.
structured_prompt: Scene: clean street. Subject count: 1. Subject 1: young boy in gray jacket. Motion: move from left to right across the frame. Camera: gentle follow, no cut, preserve identity. Priority: path clarity first, then style.

title: 进入房间
user_input: 一个人从门外进入房间，镜头轻推跟随进入，要能看出从外到内的空间变化。
plain_prompt: A person enters a room from outside, the camera gently pushes and follows inward, show the space transition from outside to inside.
structured_prompt: Scene: doorway transition. Subject count: 1. Subject 1: adult entering from outside into a room. Motion: pass through the door into the interior. Camera: gentle push-in follow, keep spatial transition clear, no abrupt cut. Priority: entering action and doorway relation first.

title: 两人擦肩而过
user_input: 两个人在狭窄走廊里擦肩而过，一个向前走，一个回头看，关系要清楚。
plain_prompt: Two people pass each other in a narrow corridor, one walks forward while the other looks back, keep their relation clear.
structured_prompt: Scene: narrow corridor. Subject count: 2. Subject 1: walking forward. Subject 2: passing by and looking back. Motion: preserve separate paths, keep front-back relation clear. Camera: stable tracking, no extra people. Priority: two-person relation and crossing path.

title: 前后景人物同时运动
user_input: 前景人物向前走，中景人物停顿后转身，后景门打开，三个动作要分层清楚。
plain_prompt: A foreground person walks forward, a midground person pauses then turns around, and a background door opens, the three actions should stay layered clearly.
structured_prompt: Scene: layered interior motion. Object count: 3 action layers. Foreground subject walks forward. Midground subject pauses then turns. Background door opens. Camera: hold composition stable enough to keep layered actions readable. Priority: layered action separation first.

title: 进入房间再进入下一个房间
user_input: 一个人从走廊进入第一个房间，然后穿过门进入下一个房间，镜头持续跟随，无跳切。
plain_prompt: A person walks from a corridor into the first room, then passes through a doorway into the next room, camera follows continuously, no cuts.
structured_prompt: Scene: continuity sequence across connected rooms. Subject count: 1. Path: corridor -> first room -> doorway -> second room. Camera: continuous follow, no-cut, no teleport, preserve room-to-room spatial bridge. Priority: path continuity and space transition first.

title: 静态结构 + 强运动冲突
user_input: 人物站在原地，但文本要求他冲向下一个房间，希望镜头不要乱掉。
plain_prompt: A person stands in place, but also wants to rush into the next room, keep the camera stable.
structured_prompt: Scene: static composition conflict case. Subject count: 1. Structure priority: keep subject in the same mark for the whole shot. Motion intent is emotional only, not real displacement. Camera: static, no extra push or follow. Priority: static structure over movement wording.
